title: Register for Cardiovascular Events under new cancer Therapies
summary: A registry to prospectively assess the incidence of cardiovascular events and identify clinical risk factors under new oncological therapies.
conditions: Squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck area

interventions.name:
Baseline examination (detailed medical history and survey of previous illnesses, questionnaire on sporting activity).
Determination of vital signs, a 12-lead ECG, an LCEKG if necessary, and an echocardiography. 
Laboratory examination (incl. HSTroponin T, NT-pro BNP, HS-CRP).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients prior to initiation of a therapy with a checkpoint inhibitor for the treatment of a malignant disease
• Patients prior to initiation of a therapy or under therapy with a BTK inhibitor for the treatment of a malignant disease
• Patients prior to initiation  of a therapy with the combination of BRAF and MEK inhibitors for the treatment of a malignant disease
• Age> 18 years
• Educational ability: The patient must be able to understand and to sign the declaration of consent. He must be sufficiently proficient in the German language.
Exclusion criteria:
• Lack of consent
• Pregnant or breastfeeding women
• Patient depending on or in relation to the sponsor or PI
• Life expectancy <12 months due to illness
• Patients unable to give informed consent
